"""Verify the full cooldown with Jetson models and audio, without opening a servo port."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
import numpy as np
from robot import audio, servo
from robot.config import ROOT, SHARED
from robot.head import Head
from robot.main import Robot
from bench.head_sim import TurningCamera, converse, head_state, load, until


def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
    raise AssertionError('No real serial connection is permitted in this simulation')


servo.connect = forbidden
# Compile the one existing packet fake without importing pytest into the robot environment.
source = ROOT / 'tools/test_servo.py'
node = next(n for n in ast.parse(source.read_text()).body
            if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == 'Packet')
namespace = {}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node], type_ignores=[]), str(source), 'exec'), namespace)
packet = namespace['Packet']()
transport = servo.Servo(SimpleNamespace(is_using=False), packet, 1)
motor = servo.SerialMotor(transport, 2048, 1, 60)
head = Head(motor)
folder = SHARED / 'experiments' / f'thermal-sim-{time.time_ns()}'
result = {'machine': 'Jetson', 'release': os.environ['ROBOT_RELEASE'],
          'tegrastats': os.environ['ROBOT_TEGRASTATS'], 'source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
          'packet_source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'hardware_motion': False, 'input': 'Oracle text and development photos; real microphone capture fed as silence; USB speaker playback',
          'status': 'failed', 'turns': [], 'samples': [], 'microphone_chunks': 0}
output = SHARED / 'results' / f'2026-10-16-thermal-sim-{time.time_ns()}.json'
stop = threading.Event()
robot = microphone = None
failures = []


def speak(text):
    turn = converse(robot, text)
    result['turns'].append({'question': text, 'answer': turn.answer,
                            'audio_s': turn.audio_s, 'wav': str(robot.out / turn.wav),
                            'cooling': head.cooling, 'head_error': head.error})
    assert turn.answer and turn.audio_s > 0
    return turn


def capture():
    try:
        for chunk in audio.mic():
            if stop.is_set():
                break
            robot.hear(np.zeros_like(chunk))
            result['microphone_chunks'] += 1
    except BaseException as error:
        failures.append(repr(error))


try:
    center = load(ROOT / 'eval/faces/scenes/dev-p05-enroll-a.jpg')
    camera = TurningCamera(head, center, load(ROOT / 'eval/dev/live/closet-cat-center.jpg'),
                           load(ROOT / 'eval/dev/live/closet-stopsign-center.jpg'))
    robot = Robot(camera, folder / 'session', folder / 'memory', wake_word=False, head=head)
    microphone = threading.Thread(target=capture, daemon=True)
    microphone.start()
    time.sleep(2)
    speak('Remember me, my name is Dylan.')
    speak('Yes.')
    packet.memory[63] = 65
    until(lambda: head.cooling, 3, 'thermal cooldown')
    released = motor.cooldown_until - servo.COOLDOWN_S
    result['release_monotonic'] = released
    assert packet.memory[40] == 0 and not head.error and not motor.closed
    warning = speak('What is on your left?')
    assert 'cooling' in warning.answer.lower() and not warning.frame_id
    robot._control('stop_head', {})
    packet.memory[63] = 50
    writes = len(packet.writes)
    chunks = result['microphone_chunks']
    speak('How are you?')
    spoke_again = False
    deadline = motor.cooldown_until
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        robot.check_health()
        assert (head.cooling or time.monotonic() >= deadline) and packet.memory[40] == 0
        assert len(packet.writes) == writes
        assert not failures, failures
        elapsed = time.monotonic() - released
        result['samples'].append({'elapsed_s': elapsed, 'head': head_state(head),
                                  'torque': packet.memory[40], 'temperature_c': packet.memory[63],
                                  'microphone_chunks': result['microphone_chunks'],
                                  'detections': robot.detections})
        if elapsed > 60 and not spoke_again:
            speak('What do you see?')
            spoke_again = True
        time.sleep(.5)
    until(lambda: not head.cooling, 15, 'cooldown recovery')
    result['recovery_s'] = time.monotonic() - released
    assert result['recovery_s'] >= 180
    assert not motor.enabled and packet.memory[40] == 0 and not head.following
    assert len(packet.writes) == writes and result['microphone_chunks'] > chunks + 100
    packet.memory[56] += 30
    speak('How are you?')
    assert head.awaiting_motion and packet.memory[40] == 0 and len(packet.writes) == writes
    result['passive_displacement_stayed_off'] = True
    speak('Talk to Dylan.')
    packet.memory[63] = 70
    until(lambda: motor.thermal_latched and head.cooling, 3, 'latched head protection')
    speak('What is on your right?')
    robot.check_health()
    assert not head.error and packet.memory[40] == 0
    result['final_head'] = head_state(head)
    result['status'] = 'passed'
except BaseException as error:
    result['error'] = repr(error)
    raise
finally:
    stop.set()
    if microphone:
        microphone.join(5)
    result['microphone_failures'] = failures
    result['microphone_stopped'] = microphone is None or not microphone.is_alive()
    if robot:
        robot.close()
    result['final_torque'] = packet.memory[40]
    result['packet_writes'] = packet.writes
    result['session'] = str(folder)
    output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({'result': str(output), 'status': result['status'],
                      'recovery_s': result.get('recovery_s'),
                      'microphone_chunks': result['microphone_chunks']}), flush=True)
